text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fans watch the track with high hopes for the impressive field gathered to run the autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tosen Jordan's friends are watching too, praying all her efforts will pay off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: For her part, Jordan tells me she's going to run a race that will change both trends and history.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's going to make the most out of all of her training and everything she's learned up until now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She tells me to keep believing in her as she strives to become the greatest dummy.
